The first space nation

UAE's long-term vision for the future

Guided by visionary leadership, the UAE is transitioning from a resource-based to a hiTech economy driven by the space program. This strategy propels UAE towards leadership in Exploration, R&D and Investment.

From historic vision to structured roadmap

A 1974 meeting with NASA set the foundation for UAE's vision for space. Under the visionary leadership of UAE government this vision evolved into a clear mandate: position the UAE as a global leader in Space Exploration, Research & Investment. The UAE now advances sovereign missions, contributes to the Lunar Gateway, and invests in technologies, governance and infrastructure that enable long-term human presence beyond Earth.

Why an ecosystem is essential

To sustain this trajectory, the UAE requires a robust local ecosystem which develops talent, aligns regulations, attracts private capital, and accelerates technology transfer into the country. XperienceSpace complements UAE's vision by providing a structured collaboration platform which develops industry & community.

Core framework

4 Pillars powering XperienceSpace

Each pillar channels community energy, builds capabilities, and supports UAE's official space initiatives with practical, investment-ready mechanisms.

PILLAR 01

Public Engagement & Community

Raising awareness and inspiring innovation by addressing Earth's challenges, creating new opportunities for UAE's growth in the space economy. A space for Emiratis to touch their dreams.

PILLAR 02

Education & Talent Pipeline

Developing future leaders by applying UAE-driven solutions to global and space challenges, strengthening national expertise and resilience.

PILLAR 03

Industry Development & Support

Creating initiatives to develop cutting-edge solutions addressing local and global needs, driving UAE's leadership in space and hiTech industries.

PILLAR 04

Research & Development

Developing products & services needed to solve Earth's sustainability challenges and build a competitive, future-ready space sector for UAE.

Ecosystem in action

Making the space vision investable, practical and inclusive

The XperienceSpace ecosystem connects community, academia, industry, investors and government stakeholders into one coherent platform designed to attract technology, talent and capital into the UAE.

UAE Space Community

A national movement where youth, families, professionals and creators participate in UAE space initiatives through digital platforms, outreach programs, events, challenges and learning pathways.

Future Development Funds

A series of hiTech funds channeling private and institutional capital into UAE-based solutions.

  • Global leadership — a preferred hub for space collaboration and responsible development
  • Economic diversification — new industries, exportable services and IP anchored in the UAE
  • Societal impact — youth engagement, national pride, clear pathways into future industries
  • Talent & employment — high-value jobs in engineering, AI, robotics, medicine, sustainability
  • Faster, cheaper missions — local supply chains reduce cost and time to deliver

Strategic trajectory

From programs to a fully functioning UAE Space City

A scalable, future-ready special economic zone developed as an industry and community focal point supporting the UAE vision for space — dedicated to innovation, education, enterprise and cutting-edge technologies.

NOW–2030

Foundation & Awareness

  • Launch UAE Space Welcome Center, virtual community, outreach programs and academies
  • Create Special Economic Zone & infrastructure
  • Power & Water Generation facilities, Environmental Park, Hyper-Computing Center, AI/Communications hub
  • First-phase Habitat Development Hub with Biome analog facility
2030–2040

Space City & Industry Scale-Up

  • Dedicated zones for advanced manufacturing, simulation, materials, space medicine and logistics
  • Residential & tourism programs integrated with smart-city design
  • Grow UAE-based IP portfolio and services for regional & global markets
2040–2117

Deep-Space Economy & Mars-2117 Support

  • UAE as a strategic hub for deep-space missions, asteroid research, life support technologies and Mars infrastructure
  • A diversified space-driven economy
  • Programs: Food BIOME, Olympus, Eyes on Universe, Arkisys, asteroid missions, local fabrication

Gateway to the vision

UAE Space Welcome Center & Community

The jewel of UAE Space City — a physical and virtual gateway where Emiratis, residents and visitors from across the globe experience the nation's journey to space and discover how they can participate.

Immersive Experiences

Interactive exhibits, mission simulators, planet environments and a rocket viewing gallery. Space museum & the story of UAE's journey to space, space café, merchandise store, live space stream, events & forums.

Education & Talent Pipeline

A bridge between accredited education providers, industry partners and government programs — workshops & youth academies, professional training in hiTech fields, university & research collaboration zones.

Industry & R&D Collaboration

A neutral collaboration zone connecting companies, investors and agencies — showcase of UAE-based technologies, access to labs & prototype spaces, support for projects & funding.

Collaboration network model

Led by industry experts — aligned with national leadership

What we do

  • Promote & support UAE national programs for space, economic growth and community development
  • Translate UAE space objectives into clear engagement and investment pathways
  • Help global partners localize capabilities, IP and operations in the UAE
  • Facilitate collaboration frameworks that respect UAE regulations and sovereign oversight
  • Connect schools, universities and industry for collaborative development programs

What we are not

  • Not a regulator, government agency or operator of national missions
  • Not a replacement for UAE institutions or official strategies
  • Not a speculative venture; programs are tied to measurable readiness and real capabilities
